description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException used within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for signaling issues when feature properties are inaccessible or non-existent on a Thing. It includes static builder methods, JSON parsing, and metadata annotations.
